units.source_text: “杉树的树干就像手工艺品般整整齐齐地排列着，这个我想象到了。

en.t: I could imagine the trunks of the cedar trees lined up as neatly as pieces of handicraft.

units.source_text: 可是杉树上方的枝叶这样像素淡的花，却没有想到。”

en.t: But I had never imagined that the branches and leaves above the cedars would look like such pale, delicate flowers.
